As an AP Accountant based in Merksem, you will play a key role in managing accounts payable processes within the industrial and manufacturing sector. This permanent position involves handling financial transactions and ensuring accuracy in the accounting and finance department.

Bedrijfsomschrijving

An organisation in the industrial and manufacturing sector located in Merksem, Antwerp.

Omschrijving

As an AP Accountant your responsibilities are:

• Ensure supplier invoices, bank transactions, and cash allocations are processed accurately and on time every day.
• Play a key role in preparing and following up on vendor payments and managing A/P reconciliations.
• Keep international cash flows running smoothly by accurately matching payments across multiple currencies.
• Investigate discrepancies and complex accounting issues, taking ownership of finding and implementing solutions.
• Ensure quality and compliance with Belgian accounting standards, VAT regulations, and internal controls.
• Build strong partnerships with colleagues across Treasury, Accounting, TCU, and the business.
• Challenge existing ways of working and actively contribute to process improvements.
• Support the ongoing digitalization and automation of our Accounts Payable processes.

A successful AP Accountant should have:

• A Bachelor's degree in Accounting, or equivalent through relevant experience.
• At least 3 years of experience in Accounts Payable or operational accounting in an international environment, enabling you to work independently.
• Solid knowledge of invoice processing, reconciliations, payments and closing activities.
• Accurate and analytical, with the ability to investigate discrepancies and identify practical improvements.
• Hands-on, proactive and comfortable working in a high-volume and evolving environment.
• Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 is highly valued.
• Excellent command of English an good knowledge in Dutch.

jobs.occupation: Customer Support Advisor: English + German + 1 other European Language - Multiple Shifts - Oostakker
jobs.description:
For our client we're looking for a Customer Service Officer.
In this role, you become the voice of support for drivers facing unexpected vehicle issues across Europe. You'll be part of a fast-paced and multilingual contact center where your communication skills, empathy, and sense of urgency play a crucial role in keeping transport moving.
 

 
• Handle incoming assistance requests from international customers experiencing roadside vehicle breakdowns. 
 
• Take ownership of each case by coordinating with local service providers and technicians until the issue is resolved. 
 
• Maintain constant communication with both the customer and service partner, providing regular updates and reassurance. 
 
• Think on your feet and apply a proactive approach to problem-solving, often finding creative solutions under time pressure. 
 
• Be an integral part of a tight-knit, multilingual team that thrives on collaboration and mutual support. 
 
• Operate within a 24/7 environment, where teamwork and flexibility are essential to ensuring seamless customer experiences. 

- You speak and write fluently in English, German and at least one other European language. 

 
• Service-driven and naturally inclined to go the extra mile to support customers in stressful situations. 
 
• Strong interpersonal skills help you adapt your communication style to various cultural and professional contexts. 
 
• You enjoy working in a diverse team setting and are always ready to help others succeed. 
 
• Flexibility to work in a rotating shift schedule, including nights and weekends. 
 
• A hands-on mentality with a structured and solution-oriented mindset. 
 
• Eagerness to continuously develop your skills and embrace new challenges.

As a production worker, you will work together with a colleague every day to manufacture safety boots 👢. You will place components such as the steel toe cap, lining and sole into the mould. The machine automatically injects the plastic, after which you remove the finished boot. In between production runs, you clean the machine to ensure it is ready for the next production cycle.

After training, you will also be able to operate other machines. You will cut away larger excess pieces and trim fine seams ✂️. You will carry out quality checks and pay close attention to detail. Every boot must meet strict quality standards. With your keen eye for detail, you make sure that only top-quality products leave the facility.

Working together with your colleagues is important. You step in where needed and support each other in achieving the production targets. You work accurately and take pride in the end result. Are you eager to learn and quality-focused? Then this could be the opportunity for you! ✅

Sound like the job for you? Apply now and discover how you can make a difference!

Who are we looking for?

• You have some initial stable experience in a production environment ⚙️
• You speak English well; Dutch is a plus.
• You have your own means of transportation (public transport is not available).
• You are attentive and have an eye for detail. 👀
• You can work at a fast pace and are physically fit. 💪
• You are not afraid of physically demanding work.

Our client is a well-established international organisation with a strong reputation for operational excellence and a people-focused culture. 

To strengthen its local IT presence in Belgium, our client is looking for a service-oriented IT professional who enjoys working in a collaborative and multicultural environment. The organisation promotes knowledge sharing, continuous learning, and professional development while offering employees the opportunity to work closely with both local and international teams.

Jobomschrijving

As a Service Desk Analyst / IT Support Engineer (L1/L2), your responsibilities will include:

• Providing first and second-line IT support to end users.
• Managing incidents, service requests, and technical queries in line with established processes and service level agreements.
• Troubleshooting hardware, software, network, and Microsoft 365-related issues.
• Acting as the primary local IT point of contact for employees based in Belgium.
• Logging, tracking, documenting, and resolving tickets using the company's IT Service Management platform.
• Collaborating with international IT teams, vendors, and specialist support teams to resolve complex issues.
• Monitoring IT systems and escalating recurring or critical issues when required.
• Supporting IT projects, deployments, upgrades, and infrastructure changes.
• Managing employee onboarding and offboarding activities, including hardware preparation, account setup, and access management.
• Supporting meeting room technology, printers, audiovisual equipment, and local IT infrastructure.
• Creating and maintaining user documentation, knowledge base articles, and operational procedures.
• Identifying opportunities to improve processes, enhance service quality, and optimise the overall user experience.

The successful candidate will have:

• At least 2/3 years of experience in an IT Support, Service Desk, or End User Support role.
• Fluency in English & Dutch. French is a plus. 
• Strong knowledge of Microsoft 365, Windows environments, end-user computing, networking fundamentals, and IT security best practices.
• Experience managing incidents, service requests, and change-related activities.
• Hands-on experience with Active Directory and Microsoft 365 user administration.
• Excellent troubleshooting and analytical skills with the ability to resolve technical issues independently.
• Strong customer service and communication skills, with the ability to interact effectively with stakeholders at all levels.
• A structured, proactive, and solution-oriented approach to work.
• The ability to prioritise tasks and manage multiple requests in a fast-paced environment.

ITIL, Microsoft, or other relevant certifications would be considered an advantage.

On a personal level, you are recognised for your customer-centric mindset, team spirit, adaptability, and willingness to continuously learn and improve. You enjoy taking ownership, driving improvements, and delivering an outstanding support experience to end users.

Are you looking to build your career as a Junior Controller in an international industrial environment? A growing manufacturing company based in Brussels is looking for a motivated finance professional to strengthen its controlling team.

 

As a Junior Controller, you will gain valuable exposure to industrial finance, production costs and business performance. Whether you have started your career in audit or controlling, this Junior Financial Controller opportunity offers the chance to develop your analytical skills, work closely with operational teams and contribute to important financial decisions.

What you'll do as a junior controller : 

As a Junior Controller, you will work alongside experienced finance professionals and support the company's financial performance through a variety of responsibilities.

• Analyse monthly financial results and investigate variances between actual performance, budgets and forecasts.
• Monitor production costs, operating expenses and profit margins to support effective cost control.
• Prepare financial reports and management dashboards to provide clear insights into business performance.
• Support monthly closing activities and ensure the accuracy of financial information.
• Contribute to budgeting and forecasting processes in collaboration with the finance and operations teams.
• Identify cost optimisation opportunities and investigate the financial drivers behind production performance.
• Develop and improve Excel reports and financial analysis tools.
• Assist the Senior Controller with ad hoc analyses, reporting improvements and business projects.

What we're Looking For as a Junior Controller : 

• A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics or a related field.
• A first professional experience in audit, financial controlling.
• A genuine interest in industrial controlling, cost accounting and financial performance analysis.
• Strong analytical skills, attention to detail and a structured approach to problem solving.
• Good knowledge of Excel. Experience with SAP or another ERP system is an advantage.
• The ability to communicate financial information clearly and collaborate with non-financial stakeholders.
• Professional proficiency in English, French and a good command of Dutch.

jobs.occupation: Technical Safety Officer Maritime Operations - EN
jobs.description:
• Be present on the yard and on board vessels on a daily basis to monitor activities, risks and safety measures. 

• Carry out safety rounds, inspections and audits to identify unsafe situations and technical risks, and quickly implement the necessary corrective actions. 

• Address and raise awareness among employees and subcontractors, and ensure safety rules are applied correctly. 

• Prepare, update and follow up risk assessments, safety procedures and action points. 

• Monitor safety during maintenance and repair activities, including the safe isolation of work areas and technical installations. 

• Provide practical safety advice and discuss improvement points with Superintendents, technical staff, naval personnel, subcontractors and other stakeholders. 

• Ensure proper administrative follow-up and reporting on safety and prevention. 
 

• Strong technical background in shipping, marine engineering, industry, maintenance or complex technical worksites. 

• Experience as, for example, a Superintendent, maritime Project Manager, Engineer, Technical Specialist or in an operational role on board is a strong foundation. 

• Good technical understanding of areas such as mechanics, electricity, hydraulics, maintenance activities, working at height, heavy loads and technical spaces. 

• Strong interest in safety and prevention; previous experience in a formal safety role is not required. 

• Strong communication skills, a practical mindset and the ability to engage people clearly and convincingly in safe working practices. 

• Natural authority, assertiveness and, above all, a genuine passion for making safety visible and intervening when necessary. 

• Flexible, approachable and willing to spend most of your time on the work floor. 

• Good command of English; knowledge of Dutch and French is an advantage.

• Manage procurement, inventory, repairable items and physical material flows. 

• Anticipate shortages, delays and risks that could impact vessel availability. 

• Coordinate transport, customs and urgent logistics flows. 

• Monitor suppliers, logistics partners, contracts and performance. 

• Integrate Supply Chain requirements into Procurement, Engineering, Maintenance and Programme Management. 

• Define and monitor KPIs related to availability, inventory, procurement, repairs and supplier performance. 

• Improve processes, data quality and ERP usage across the Supply Chain.  

ISS: In-Service Support

 

• Master’s degree in Engineering or an equivalent technical qualification. 

• At least 5 years of relevant experience in a complex industrial Supply Chain environment. 

• Experience as a Supply Chain Manager, Supply Chain Programme Manager or within ISS/Support is a strong asset. 

• Experience in the naval, defence, aerospace, rail, energy or complex technical systems sector is an advantage. 

• Good knowledge of planning, procurement, inventory management, logistics flows, transport and supplier management. 

• Excellent command of Excel and solid experience with ERP systems and KPI reporting. 

• Professional proficiency in French and English. 

• Strong analytical skills, results-driven and passionate about your field, with the ability to prioritise and respond quickly. 

• Strong leadership skills and the ability to bring together different internal and external stakeholders.
